label: On-Seam (Side Seam)
description: An on-seam (vertical) pocket hides its opening directly within the trouser's side seam, so the entry is virtually invisible from the front. This creates the cleanest, most formal silhouette with no line interrupting the front of the trouser, though access is slightly less convenient than a slant. It is the traditional choice for dress and suit trousers.
